login.title: Sign in to Canopy
login.description: Enter your username and password to continue.

welcome.title: Welcome to Canopy
welcome.description: Let's get your file manager ready. This takes about a minute and only happens once.

account.title: Create the administrator
account.description: This account manages Canopy: users, permissions and settings. You can add more people later.
account.usernameHint: 3–32 characters: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
account.displayNameHint: Optional. Shown in the interface instead of the username.
account.contactEmailHint: Optional. Used for notifications and password resets once email is configured.
account.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A passphrase is easier to remember.

errors.username: Use 3–32 characters: letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.contactEmail: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.

done.title: You're all set
done.description: Your administrator account is ready and you are signed in. Next, mount a folder inside the engine root to start browsing.

notLocal.title: Setup is only available locally
notLocal.description: For safety, the first administrator can only be created from your local network. Open Canopy from a device on the same network as the server, or add your network to CANOPY_LOCAL_NETWORKS.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Your account is protected by a second step. Open your authenticator app to continue.
twoFactor.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your app, or one of your recovery codes.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app (such as Aegis, 2FAS or 1Password) at every sign-in.
totp.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
totp.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
totp.recoveryDescription: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe: they won't be shown again.
totp.disableDescription: Two-factor authentication will be turned off and your recovery codes deleted.
totp.regenerateDescription: Your current recovery codes will stop working.
